correctness.rationale: All field and dimension assumptions explicitly handled. Divisor kernel classification follows by splitting V=kv⊕W and alternating bivector rank. Proper smooth vector-bundle incidence and a regular unique-divisor inverse establish the reduced variety dimension and smooth stratum. At decomposable tensors an explicit span of linear incidence fibers has tangent dimension binom(n,2)+(n-5)(n-2), strictly larger than dimension for n≥6. Gaussian fiber counts give the exact disjoint rank distribution. Perfect exterior pairings establish n=6 cohomology. Standalone exhaustive F2 dimension-six wedge maps and characteristic 2,3,5 graded maps succeeded; finite tests do not establish the general result.

value.rationale: The divisor locus is intrinsic to exterior multiplication and precisely the rank-deficient locus of V→Λ⁴V. The theorem uniformly gives dimension, irreducibility, singular locus and exact numbers of each possible multiplication rank for all n≥6 over all finite fields; the n=6 cohomology distribution demonstrates natural algebraic use. These are natural geometric and arithmetic invariants rather than an arbitrary isolated enumerative slice.
